title: Shepherd Path
purpose: Help children follow Psalm 23s poetic images and connect each image to care.
body_markdown:
# Shepherd Path

Create five stops:

1. Green pasture and water - provision and rest
2. Right path - guidance
3. Dark valley - danger and God's presence
4. Table and cup - welcome and abundance
5. House - enduring belonging

## Teacher note

Psalm 23 is poetry. Do not literalise every image or promise a life without danger or grief.
